exercises.why: **Поставь** — поста́вить (perfective): to put, to place, to set, to stand, to station (In a vertical position); to apply, to put on (a compress); to put on stage, to stage, to produce, to present (a play); (gambling) to wager, to place a bet, to stake. Wiktionary: по- + ста́вить.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to put, to place, to set, to stand, to station (In a vertical position)
to compel, to force, to make
to put forward, to move out, to put outside, to bring forward, to place in front
to insert, to put in, to paste
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: поста́вить — to put, to place, to set, to stand, to station (In a vertical position); заста́вить — to compel, to force, to make; вы́ставить — to put forward, to move out, to put outside, to bring forward, to place in front; вста́вить — to insert, to put in, to paste.
**вставил** — вста́вить (perfective): to insert, to put in, to paste. Wiktionary: в- + ста́вить.
